title: Leia Organa
description: A precocious girl of 10 adopted by the Royal Family of Alderaan as an infant, Leia Organa would rather flee to the woods and watch the starships arrive than attend formal ceremonies. Strong-willed and independent, Leia had no qualms saying exactly what was on her mind—even if it wasn't politically expedient. Unfortunately, at that age, she was the victim of a kidnapping plot hatched by the Inquisitorius to lure Obi-Wan Kenobi into their clutches. Kenobi found that she possessed so much of both her biological parents' spirit in her.
